name: parse-csv
instruction:
Implement parseCsv(text) in csv.js (currently a stub). The first line is the header row. Return an array of objects, one per data row, keyed by header, with all values as trimmed strings. Ignore blank lines, accept both 
 and 
 line endings, and ignore a trailing newline. No quoted-field handling is needed. Example: "name,age
Ann,30
Bo,25" -> [{name:"Ann",age:"30"},{name:"Bo",age:"25"}]. Empty input returns [].
